infra:Foundations.evidence: astryx/astryx.tamber (251 tokens) and tokens/themes.tamber (8 themes, 1,066 per-theme values), imported by Exact's own `contract tamber import astryx`; gallery case foundations-0001 on web and Linux.
infra:Foundations.notes: 279 of 286 resolved tokens map; 7 do not (duration min/max tiers, focus outline style). The 4 motion tokens cannot vary by theme (Tamber writes a duration or easing into its transition at build), so every theme uses the default theme's motion. A type role (`font`) varies by theme, so it must sit on each text, not on a container. Number and date formatting stay en-US in Contract (a data module would localise, but the Linux build carries none).

VisuallyHidden.notes: Contract refuses clip-path inset(); a 1 px clipped box stands in.

SizeContext.notes: No context through a slot: size is a prop each child takes.

InteractiveRoleContext.notes: No context through a slot: role is a prop.

Text.notes: `font` takes only literals, so the type role is a chain of literals. No inline-flex. `textWrap` keeps auto/balance plus nowrap; `pretty` is refused. Truncation tooltip waits for Tooltip (wave 4).

Icon.evidence: astryx/icons.contract (29 icons from defaultIcons.tsx as one path each); gallery icon-*
Icon.notes: Contract expands a component at each use, so a branch per icon repeated all 29 icons at every Icon: one path chosen by a function keeps Icon small. Custom icon registry (registerIcons) has no Contract equivalent: icons are known at build.

Spinner.notes: Turn is a CSS keyframe; reduced motion not yet wired.

Kbd.notes: Mod shows as the Command sign on every platform for now.

Divider.notes: isFullBleed needs the container's padding, which Contract cannot read (no runtime CSS variables): ignored.

Link.notes: Hover underline thickness refused (a state row paints only); hover dims instead. LinkProvider (router swap) is Contract's own `link`/routes.

Avatar.notes: Initials use the first letter of the first and last words (no Unicode-aware search). Image fallbackSrc and load error not yet wired. Tooltip waits for wave 4.

AvatarGroup.notes: Members are data (AvatarItem[]), not child elements: one slot cannot be counted.

Stack.notes: A library cannot size a node on its slot's chain from a prop, so free sizes (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are the caller's wrapping view. Padding is physical (left/right): Contract refuses logical CSS; the page mirrors under RTL. `as` (element type) dropped. StackItem ported.

HStack.notes: Contract forwards no slot into another component, so HStack repeats Stack's body instead of wrapping Stack.

VStack.notes: As HStack: no slot forwarding, so it repeats Stack's body.

Grid.notes: A library cannot size a node on its slot's chain from a prop, so free sizes (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are the caller's wrapping view. rowHeight not yet wired.

Center.notes: A library cannot size a node on its slot's chain from a prop, so free sizes (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are the caller's wrapping view. isInline dropped (no inline-flex).

AspectRatio.notes: fit (cover/contain) applies to an image child, set by the caller.

Layout.notes: Astryx takes header/start/end/footer as named props; Contract has one slot, so LayoutHeader, LayoutPanel, LayoutContent and LayoutFooter are children that place themselves on the frame's grid. Edge compensation through --container-padding-* custom properties has no equivalent. Panel width is a zero-height strut; content width is padding. No container queries.

Section.notes: Nested full-bleed (cancel the container's padding) needs the padding by prop (`bleed`): no runtime custom properties, no context through a slot.

Card.notes: A library cannot size a node on its slot's chain from a prop, so free sizes (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are the caller's wrapping view. Border inset compensation (padding minus border) dropped.

Toolbar.notes: Arrow-key roving focus waits for wave 5 controls; overflow menu waits for OverflowList (wave 6).

Token.notes: href/onClick variants and endContent not yet wired.

infra:Layers.notes: The platform's top layer does the layer stack, focus, Escape and outside-press dismissal (`popover`, `dialog`). A popover anchors only to the control that opened it (position-area); no anchoring to another element, no collision flipping beyond the platform's, no portal. Exact holds a library to always showing its slot, so every component that hides its content until opened (Popover, Collapsible, Tooltip, Dialog, menus, sheets) lives in a second, plain package (@astryx-spike/astryx-layers) beside the library.

infra:Motion.notes: Keyframes take literals, so presets carry the default theme's durations and easings. A library cannot read reduced motion (the viewport is the app's root resource): moving components take `still`. Exit animations do not run on Linux. Animating to an auto height is not possible (numeric heights only): Collapsible content rises in instead.

Collapsible.notes: Trigger is a `title` (one slot, used by the content). Open state is the caller's (`isOpen`, `toggle`): a slot passes no context, so CollapsibleGroup cannot coordinate its children; single/multiple is the caller's state. Not a library component: it hides its slot.

Popover.notes: Trigger is the caller's button (`popovertarget`). Placement maps to position-area; isModal, hasAutoFocus and presentation (bottom-sheet/adaptive) not yet wired (adaptive needs the viewport, which only the app root reads). Headless Linux `showPopover` is reported unsupported by Exact's docs, yet the anchored popover rendered in our headless run.

Tooltip.evidence: gallery tooltip-*; test 'a tooltip case opens its tooltip'
Tooltip.notes: Shows on hover and focus via the platform popover, anchored to the trigger. Timers run only in the app root's tasks, so `delay` is the fade's delay (the tooltip is open, transparent, for `delay` ms) and hideDelay is not possible. Content is text (one slot: the trigger). touchTrigger tap not wired. Hover is web and desktop only.

InfoTip.notes: Opens on hover and on press (popovertarget).

HoverCard.notes: Card content is a title and body text: the one slot is the trigger. Same delay limit as Tooltip.

Button.evidence: gallery button-*; playground test presses Save (web and Linux)
Button.notes: A native button drawn in Astryx's look. isInterruptible not wired. Press scale is a paint-only :active opacity (a state row cannot scale).

ButtonGroup.notes: A slot passes no context and Contract has no :first-child, so each Button takes `groupEdge` from the caller to square its inner corners. Group-wide size and isDisabled are each Button's props.

Switch.evidence: gallery switch-*; playground test toggles it (web and Linux)
Switch.notes: A native checkbox (role switch) lies transparent over the drawn track and thumb. Drag-to-toggle (touch) not wired.

TextInput.evidence: gallery text-input-*; playground test types and clears (web; Linux by the agent's type)
TextInput.notes: No :focus-within: the field's focus and blur set the ring through component state. hasAutoCorrect and hasSpellCheck have no Contract attribute. Real-keyboard editing on Linux not verified (the agent sets the value).

NumberInput.evidence: gallery numberinput-*; playground test steps it
NumberInput.notes: Value is text; parse and clamp are the caller's (parseNumber).

CheckboxInput.evidence: gallery checkboxinput-*; playground test checks it
CheckboxInput.notes: aria-checked takes only a bool: an indeterminate box reads as unchecked.

RadioList.evidence: gallery radiolist-*; playground test picks an option
RadioList.notes: Options are data (ChoiceItem[]), not RadioListItem children: one slot cannot tell a list which child is chosen.

Field.notes: The control is the slot and names itself by the label's id.

InputGroup.notes: Parts are the slot (InputGroupText, an input).

SegmentedControl.evidence: gallery segmented-control-*; playground test picks a segment
SegmentedControl.notes: A library control must be the native one, so each segment is a transparent radio input over its drawn segment. Items are data.

infra:Gestures.evidence: BottomSheet grabber drag, Resizable handle drag, ReorderList drag (tests pass on web)
infra:Gestures.notes: Pointer events (pointerdown/move/up) with component state cover drags. No gesture arena: competing gestures (a sheet drag inside a scroll) are not arbitrated. Reorder is the host's (`reorderdrop` on a vertical virtualized list). Keyboard reorder (Space, arrows, Enter on the grip) did not move a row in our web run: the grip is exposed as a generic, unfocused element (gaps.test.contract keeps the failing test).

Item.notes: Start and end content are an icon name and text; the slot is extra end content. Swipe actions not wired (Contract has row `delete=` and a scroll-snap long form).

List.notes: Rows are the slot (ListItem); a slot passes no context, so each row takes the list's density, divider and marker. Reorderable lists are ReorderList (data rows). Edge compensation by custom properties dropped.

TreeList.evidence: gallery tree-list-*; playground test opens, closes and selects
TreeList.notes: Items are flattened rows with a depth (no recursion in a view). Open state is the caller's. Keyboard tree navigation (arrow keys) not wired.

Dialog.evidence: gallery dialog-*; playground test opens and closes
Dialog.notes: The platform's modal `dialog` (focus trap, inert page, Escape via closedby). Opened by showModal or commandfor, not by an isOpen prop: a dialog that state holds open is not available in Contract yet. isInline not possible. Lives in astryx-layers (hides its slot).

BottomSheet.evidence: gallery bottomsheet-*; playground test opens it
BottomSheet.notes: A modal dialog at the bottom edge with a grabber; dragging down past 120 px closes it (pointer events). Snap points and detents not wired.

DropdownMenu.evidence: gallery dropdownmenu-*; playground test picks an item
DropdownMenu.notes: The platform menu (popover role=menu). Items are data (MenuItem[]); submenus, radio groups and type-ahead not wired.

ContextMenu.evidence: gallery contextmenu-*; playground test picks an item
ContextMenu.notes: contextPopover on the slot: right click and long press.

Resizable.evidence: gallery resizable-*; playground test drags the handle 60 px
Resizable.notes: Width is the caller's state; drag by pointer events. Arrow-key resizing not wired. In astryx-layers: the library cannot size a slot-holding node from a prop.

Typeahead.evidence: gallery typeahead-*; playground test filters and picks
Typeahead.notes: The Combobox root. A field plus a listbox popover; filtering in the view; Enter picks the highlighted option. Contract refuses aria-activedescendant and aria-autocomplete, so the highlighted option is drawn, not announced; options are buttons in the tab order. Arrow-key highlight not wired (an input takes no key event). Async sources are the caller's (no data module in a Linux build).

Tokenizer.evidence: gallery tokenizer-*; playground test adds and removes
Tokenizer.notes: Tokens and a typeahead in one field. Backspace-to-remove not wired. Contract refuses aria-activedescendant and aria-autocomplete, so the highlighted option is drawn, not announced; options are buttons in the tab order.

Selector.notes: A trigger and a listbox popover. Contract refuses aria-activedescendant and aria-autocomplete, so the highlighted option is drawn, not announced; options are buttons in the tab order. Type-ahead in the list not wired.

MultiSelector.evidence: gallery multiselector-*; playground test chooses several
MultiSelector.notes: Selector with isMultiple. aria-multiselectable is refused.

Calendar.evidence: gallery calendar-*; playground test moves a month and picks a day
Calendar.notes: Month grid from day arithmetic (Zeller's congruence) in Contract functions: no date library. Names are English (Contract formats dates en-US); other calendar systems and locales are not possible without a data module. Arrow-key grid navigation not wired.

DateInput.notes: ISO text field plus a calendar popover. Segmented date entry and locale formats not possible (en-US only).

DateRangeInput.notes: DateInput with isRange; the calendar shades the range.

TimeInput.notes: 24-hour HH:MM text field; no locale 12-hour format, no segment stepping.

DateTimeInput.notes: No separate component: the two fields side by side.

Pagination.notes: Ellipsis for long ranges not wired.

Table.evidence: gallery table-*; playground test sorts, selects all and one, pages
Table.notes: Columns and rows are data; a row is its cells in column order (Contract has no records keyed by a run-time string). Sorting, selection, pagination, tree rows are the caller's state; the table draws them. Not honoured: verticalAlign (cells take no vertical-align top/bottom) and hasHover=false (a state class chosen by a prop is refused). Not wired: column resize, sticky columns, virtualization (aria-rowcount/rowindex refused), filtering UI, column settings, grouped rows.

AppShell.evidence: gallery app-shell-*; shell-nav template (web and Linux)
AppShell.notes: One slot: TopNav, SideNav and AppShellContent are children that place themselves on the shell's grid. Folding the side navigation into a drawer on narrow screens is the app root's choice (only the root reads the viewport); the shell-nav template does it with a BottomSheet.

TopNav.notes: start and end content are one slot; a flex spacer separates them.

SideNav.notes: Resizing composes Resizable; header/topContent/sections are the slot. SideNavItem ported.

CommandPalette.evidence: gallery command-palette-*; shell-nav test opens it from search and runs a command; ⌘K via keycapture on the app root
CommandPalette.notes: A modal dialog with a filtering list. Commands are data (no async search source in a Linux build). activedescendant refused: arrow-key highlight not announced; Enter runs the first match.

infra:Compositions.evidence: apps/astryx-shell-nav (6 tests) and apps/astryx-settings-dialog (5 tests) pass on web; both render and respond on the Linux host
infra:Compositions.notes: Both templates rebuilt from the Astryx page sources. Linux: popover menus are not presented (Exact logs 'Linux does not support popover presentation'), so the shell's menu bar and selectors open nothing there; trees, switches, text and panels work.

Chat.evidence: astryx-layers/chat.contract; gallery chatmessage-*, chatcomposer-*; playground-0004 tests send a message with a mention and fold tool calls (web)
Chat.notes: contenteditable is refused, so the composer is Contract's Markdown textarea with inline atoms: @mentions are pills the caret skips and delete removes whole (web, macOS, iOS; Linux, Windows and Android show the source text). Not possible: pasted-text tokens as rich chips, arbitrary inline elements, dictation without a data module (Exact's speech package needs one). The message list is a virtualized list that follows its end; aria-rowcount is not needed.

PowerSearch.evidence: gallery powersearch-*; playground test adds and removes filters (web)
PowerSearch.notes: Filter tokens plus a suggestion listbox (field names, then a field's values after `field:`). Combobox ARIA (activedescendant, autocomplete) is refused, so suggestions are buttons in the tab order. Operator menus beyond `is`, async value sources and saved queries not wired.

OverflowList.evidence: gallery overflowlist-*; playground test opens the rest
OverflowList.notes: Astryx measures items against the width (ResizeObserver). A component cannot measure (geometry reads are the app root's), so the visible count is the caller's; the rest sit in a menu (popover; not presented on Linux).
